pg17_pitr.quote: PostgreSQL version 17 The current minor release is 17.11. | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/postgresql/flexible-server/concepts-backup-restore: "Azure Database for PostgreSQL takes snapshot backups of data files and stores them securely in zone-redundant storage or locally redundant storage, depending on the region. The server also backs up transaction logs when the write-ahead log (WAL) file is ready to be archived. Use these backups to restore a server to any point in time within your configured backup retention period."
pg17_pitr.note: Base backup + continuous WAL archive (E10), stated by Microsoft, with a configurable retention period (default 7 days, up to 35).

private_ca_option.note: Azure publishes no managed private-CA service (Key Vault certificates are issued through integrated public CAs or as self-signed issuer policies, not an internal PKI). Per T81 the applied answer is the owner-generated offline root, installed in the host/node trust stores - never client-side certificate pinning.
